'''Zevaas Tellaan''' was a [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who served as a [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] while the planet was occupied by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Sometime between [[3653 BBY]] and [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Tellaan, who was known as a hard-nosed supervisor, convinced the Imperial occupiers that he could lead them to [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] in a nearby [[Cave/Legends|cave]], but what they found instead was a stockpile of munitions. Tellaan promptly detonated the weapons, [[Death/Legends|killing]] himself and the Imperials he had tricked; his sacrifice served as a distraction, allowing his former employees and their families to escape off-world.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zevaas Tellaan was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', published as a tie-in to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
